vendor/gsap-3.15.0.min.js is the unmodified browser build of GSAP (the animation engine), and
vendor/ScrollTrigger-3.15.0.min.js is the unmodified browser build of its ScrollTrigger plugin.

  Package:   gsap 3.15.0 (the newest release on 2026-10-25; published 2026-04-13T13:15Z)
  Files:     dist/gsap.min.js and dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js from the npm tarball, copied byte for byte
  Tarball:   https://registry.npmjs.org/gsap/-/gsap-3.15.0.tgz
  Integrity: sha512-dMW4CWBTUK1AEEDeZc1g4xpPGIrSf9fJF960qbTZmN/QwZIWY5wgliS6JWl9/25fpTGJrMRtSjGtOmPnfjZB+A==
             (npm's dist.integrity, checked against the downloaded tarball)
  SHA-256:   92bb9a96476f983d212a2bc4f54c889039c1696dd4461d40a736860938570fbb (vendor/gsap-3.15.0.min.js)
             b0b14d67b55b0c43c756ac0b106cfcb09d0879945f6ead64451065b0672916a2 (vendor/ScrollTrigger-3.15.0.min.js)

The filenames carry the version because /vendor/ is served immutable for a year (vercel.json).
To upgrade: npm pack gsap@<new> in a scratch folder, check dist.integrity, copy
dist/gsap.min.js to vendor/gsap-<new>.min.js and dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js to
vendor/ScrollTrigger-<new>.min.js, update this file, the two script tags on every page that
loads them and the GSAP address in tests/config.test.mjs (tests/vendor.test.mjs checks they
agree), and delete the old files. On 2026-10-25 the studio repository named neither file;
check it again before deleting, and keep an old file with a record (as supabase-js-LICENSE.txt
does) while anything else still names it.

The package ships no licence file. Its licence is the one its package.json names, at the
address given there; that page is not copied here. The licence lines the tarball ships follow,
unchanged.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

package.json, the "license" field:

Standard 'no charge' license: https://gsap.com/standard-license.

README.md, the License section:

dist/gsap.min.js and dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js, the licence lines in the comment at the top of
each (the vendored files keep that comment):

 * Subject to the terms at https://gsap.com/standard-license.
